1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive __epoxy__ binder; and a solvent.

2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an __electronic component surface or other surfaces requiring thermal management__.

3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __or other surfaces requiring thermal management__. 

9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to __0.5-1.5 grams__ and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

10 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87 __or other suitable solvents__.

12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is __a thermally conductive premixed solder paste or other suitable binder__.

13 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys __or other materials suitable for cavity generation__.

14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __8-12 microns__ in size.

15 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __30-50 microns__ in size.

22 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are __100-200 microns__ in size.
